entities.summary: Mirsad Türkcan is a former professional basketball player of Bosniak origin who represented Turkey and is currently a sports agent. Standing at a height of 6 ft 9 in (2.06 m), he played the power forward position. A three-time All-EuroLeague Team member, he is also the fifth best rebounder in the EuroLeague, since the year 2000, with 1,287 total rebounds.
